children: Aspo Plc Stock Exchange Release 20 November 2026 at 15.00 EET
Aspo publishes the demerger and listing prospectus of ESL Shipping Group Plc, which has been approved by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority
The Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority has approved the Finnish-language demerger and listing prospectus of ESL Shipping Group Plc (
“ESL
Shipping
”), to be incorporated in the demerger. Aspo Plc (“
Aspo

”) has prepared and published the demerger and listing prospectus on behalf of ESL Shipping for the purposes of issuing the demerger consideration to the shareholders of Aspo and of applying for the shares in ESL Shipping to be admitted to trading on the regulated market operated by Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd.

The Board of Directors of Aspo approved and signed the demerger plan on 3 August 2026. The Board of Directors of Aspo has proposed that the Extraordinary General Meeting of Aspo to be held on 7 December 2026 would approve the demerger plan and resolve on the partial demerger of Aspo in accordance with the demerger plan.
The Finnish-language demerger and listing prospectus approved by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority will be available no later than 23 November 2026 on Aspo’s website at
, and an unofficial English translation thereof will be available at
. The demerger and listing prospectus contains more detailed information on the demerger and ESL Shipping.

About Aspo

Aspo creates value by owning and developing business operations sustainably and in the long term. Aspo's businesses – ESL Shipping and Telko – enable future-proof, sustainable choices for customers in various industries. Established in 1929, today we are together about 650 experts on land and at sea. While the Nordic region is our core market, we serve our customers with world-class solutions in 18 countries around Europe and parts of Asia.
Aspo is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki and is headquartered in Finland.
Aspo – Sustainable value creation

Investors are directed to consult the demerger and listing prospectus for more comprehensive information on ESL Shipping, its shares and the proposed demerger.
